biotools.summary: VNC-Dist is a machine learning-based pipeline for quantifying neuronal positions in the C. elegans ventral nerve cord. It combines manual neuron localization, deep learning segmentation, spline-based distance measurement, and statistical analysis to provide an efficient and accurate approach for analyzing neuronal arrangement.
